entry_lifecycle.catalyst_logic: The strip fails to extend beyond September at 4.710 and March at 4.545.
entry_lifecycle.realization_logic: September SOFR gives back a material part of the 78bp jump while oil stays near 86 and 93.

entry_rationale: September is the cleaner expression of a printed hike-cycle overshoot than adding to a mixed Australian-dollar slide.
entry_thesis: Close the Australian bill pay and the March SOFR pay, hold the 15 million Australian-dollar long, and receive 20 million of September 2027 SOFR. Cash SOFR is 3.93 while September is 4.710 after a 78bp jump, and oil is 86 and 93 rather than the old scare zone, so the pro-growth expression is that the one-session hike cycle was too much. The Australian dollar at 0.6735 is only a small drawdown from 0.6757 and stays as the cyclical long. The receive fails if September holds 4.710 and extends, or if oil returns to the scare zone.

events.rationale: September is the cleaner expression of a printed hike-cycle overshoot than adding to a mixed Australian-dollar slide.

invalidation: The September receive is invalidated if that contract holds 4.710 and the strip pushes further, or if oil moves back toward the prior scare zone. The Australian-dollar hold is invalidated if spot fails to stabilize while March SOFR at 4.545 and September at 4.710 hold the repricing.
